name: @y2-intel/mcp
description: MCP server for connecting AI agents to Y2
author: Y2

scripts.inspect:all: npm run inspect:tools && npm run inspect:resources && npm run inspect:prompts && npm run inspect:openapi && npm run inspect:no-key-error
scripts.inspect:no-key-error: npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector --cli node dist/index.js --method tools/call --tool-name y2_list_reports --tool-arg limit=1
scripts.inspect:openapi: npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector --cli node dist/index.js --method tools/call --tool-name y2_get_openapi_operation --tool-arg operationId=listReports
scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm run typecheck:extras && npm test && npm pack --dry-run && npm run inspect:all
scripts.typecheck:extras: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --strict --skipLibCheck --types node scripts/*.ts test/*.ts
